verdict.rationale: Appwrite is API-first: its CLI, SDKs, and REST API expose project/resource management, functions deployment, and all core services (auth, databases, storage) documented as programmatically accessible, and this is confirmed by hands-on probes showing a working CLI and an official MCP server for LLM/API-native access. Some caveats exist (MCP requires API keys/project ID setup), but no evidence suggests UI-only features exist.
